---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m3p4t5 ----------------------------
(* Warehouse robot fleet with an elected leader that dispatches picking
   tasks under a bounded handling capacity, with crash-failover election
   and a human administrator override. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Robots  == {"r1", "r2", "r3"}
Tasks   == {"t1", "t2", "t3", "t4"}
MaxCap  == 3
MaxTerm == 3
NoLeader == "none"

VARIABLES leader, alive, inflight, term

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Robots \cup {NoLeader}
    /\ alive \subseteq Robots
    /\ inflight \subseteq Tasks
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm

Init ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ alive = Robots
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ term = 0

Bump(t) == IF t < MaxTerm THEN t + 1 ELSE t

Elect(r) ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ r \in alive
    /\ leader' = r
    /\ term' = Bump(term)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, inflight>>

CrashLeader ==
    /\ leader # NoLeader
    /\ alive' = alive \ {leader}
    /\ leader' = NoLeader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, term>>

Dispatch(t) ==
    /\ leader # NoLeader
    /\ t \notin inflight
    /\ Cardinality(inflight) < MaxCap
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, term>>

Finish(t) ==
    /\ t \in inflight
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, term>>

AdminOverride(r) ==
    /\ leader' = r
    /\ alive' = alive \cup {r}
    /\ term' = Bump(term)
    /\ UNCHANGED inflight

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Elect(r)
    \/ CrashLeader
    \/ \E t \in Tasks : Dispatch(t)
    \/ \E t \in Tasks : Finish(t)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : AdminOverride(r)

CapacityRespected == Cardinality(inflight) <= MaxCap

vars == <<leader, alive, inflight, term>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A fleet of warehouse robots is coordinated by a single elected leader that dispatches picking tasks. The robots continuously monitor one another, and when the current leader crashes the surviving robots elect a replacement in a new term so that dispatching can continue without a central controller. The leader may hand out picking tasks to the fleet, but the number of tasks in flight at any moment must stay within the fleet's rated handling capacity so the floor never becomes congested. Robots finish tasks over time, which frees capacity for new dispatches. A human warehouse administrator holds an override: at any point the administrator can forcibly install a particular robot as leader, for example to drain a malfunctioning zone. The model tracks who the leader is, which robots are still alive, the set of tasks currently in flight, and the current term number.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of picking tasks in flight never exceeds the fleet's rated handling capacity.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m0p1t3 ----------------------------
(* Blood-bank inventory tracker: a shared versioned record updated under
   optimistic concurrency control (read-version, prepare, compare-and-commit,
   retry-on-stale). Slow-but-not-failed terminals. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Procs   == {"p1", "p2"}
Updates == {"u1", "u2"}
NoUpd   == "none"

VARIABLES applied, version, rv, pend, ack

TypeOK ==
    /\ applied \subseteq Updates
    /\ version \in 0..Cardinality(Updates)
    /\ rv \in [Procs -> 0..Cardinality(Updates)]
    /\ pend \in [Procs -> Updates \cup {NoUpd}]
    /\ ack \in [Procs -> SUBSET Updates]

Init ==
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ version = 0
    /\ rv = [p \in Procs |-> 0]
    /\ pend = [p \in Procs |-> NoUpd]
    /\ ack = [p \in Procs |-> {}]

Prepare(p, u) ==
    /\ pend[p] = NoUpd
    /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![p] = u]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, version, rv, ack>>

Read(p) ==
    /\ rv' = [rv EXCEPT ![p] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, version, pend, ack>>

Commit(p) ==
    /\ pend[p] # NoUpd
    /\ pend[p] \notin applied
    /\ rv[p] = version
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {pend[p]}
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ ack' = [ack EXCEPT ![p] = ack[p] \cup {pend[p]}]
    /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![p] = NoUpd]
    /\ UNCHANGED rv

Retry(p) ==
    /\ pend[p] # NoUpd
    /\ rv[p] # version
    /\ rv' = [rv EXCEPT ![p] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, version, pend, ack>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Procs, u \in Updates : Prepare(p, u)
    \/ \E p \in Procs : Read(p)
    \/ \E p \in Procs : Commit(p)
    \/ \E p \in Procs : Retry(p)

NoLostUpdate == \A p \in Procs : ack[p] \subseteq applied

vars == <<applied, version, rv, pend, ack>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps a single shared record of the accepted donation updates for a particular blood type. Several staff terminals may try to post updates concurrently, so the tracker uses optimistic locking: a terminal first reads the record's current version, prepares an update, and only commits if the version it read still matches the record's version at commit time. If the version has moved on because another terminal committed in the meantime, the terminal's commit is rejected and it must re-read and retry. Terminals can be arbitrarily slow, but they never fail outright, so a stale terminal simply refreshes and tries again rather than disappearing. When a commit succeeds the update is added to the record, the version advances, and the terminal is acknowledged as having landed that update. The danger this design guards against is a lost update, where one terminal's acknowledged commit is silently overwritten by a concurrent one. The model tracks the committed updates, the version counter, each terminal's last-read version, each terminal's pending update, and each terminal's acknowledged updates.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every update a terminal was acknowledged as having committed is still present in the shared record.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m3p2t0 ----------------------------
(* Pharmacy dispenser cluster with leader-election failover (silent crash,
   recover) dispensing from a conserved pool of medication units. *)
EXTENDS Naturals

Nodes   == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
Total   == 3
MaxTerm == 3
NoLeader == "none"

VARIABLES leader, alive, stock, dispensed, term

Bump(t) == IF t < MaxTerm THEN t + 1 ELSE t

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NoLeader}
    /\ alive \subseteq Nodes
    /\ stock \in 0..Total
    /\ dispensed \in 0..Total
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm

Init ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ alive = Nodes
    /\ stock = Total
    /\ dispensed = 0
    /\ term = 0

Elect(r) ==
    /\ (leader = NoLeader \/ leader \notin alive)
    /\ r \in alive
    /\ leader' = r
    /\ term' = Bump(term)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, stock, dispensed>>

CrashSilent(r) ==
    /\ r \in alive
    /\ alive' = alive \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, stock, dispensed, term>>

Recover(r) ==
    /\ alive' = alive \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, stock, dispensed, term>>

Dispense ==
    /\ leader \in alive
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ stock' = stock - 1
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, term>>

ReturnUnit ==
    /\ dispensed > 0
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed - 1
    /\ stock' = stock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, term>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Nodes : Elect(r)
    \/ \E r \in Nodes : CrashSilent(r)
    \/ \E r \in Nodes : Recover(r)
    \/ Dispense
    \/ ReturnUnit

Conservation == stock + dispensed = Total

vars == <<leader, alive, stock, dispensed, term>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser is run by a cluster of dispensing nodes, exactly one of which acts as the elected leader that authorizes each dispense. The nodes hold a fixed quantity of medication units for one drug, split between the central stock and the units already dispensed into patient pouches; no units are ever created or destroyed, only moved between these two places. The leader authorizes moving a unit from central stock into a patient pouch, and a returned or unused pouch moves a unit back into central stock. Any node can crash silently, simply dropping out of the live set without warning; if the crashed node was the leader, the remaining nodes elect a new leader so dispensing can resume. Crashed nodes may later recover and rejoin the live set. The model tracks the current leader, the set of live nodes, the units in central stock, the units dispensed, and the election term.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The units in central stock plus the units dispensed always equal the fixed total quantity of medication.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m2p3t4 ----------------------------
(* Airport baggage router: two-phase commit across three participants routing
   a bag to a chute slot, with runtime capacity changes (slots added/removed). *)
EXTENDS Naturals

AllSlots     == {"s1", "s2"}
Bags         == {"b1", "b2"}
Participants == {"scanner", "chute", "belt"}
NoTxn        == [bag |-> "-", slot |-> "-"]

VARIABLES slots, grants, txn, voted, phase

TypeOK ==
    /\ slots \subseteq AllSlots
    /\ grants \subseteq [slot: AllSlots, bag: Bags]
    /\ txn \in ([bag: Bags, slot: AllSlots] \cup {NoTxn})
    /\ voted \subseteq Participants
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}

Init ==
    /\ slots = AllSlots
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ txn = NoTxn
    /\ voted = {}
    /\ phase = "idle"

Begin(b, s) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ s \in slots
    /\ txn' = [bag |-> b, slot |-> s]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ voted' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slots, grants>>

Vote(p) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ p \notin voted
    /\ voted' = voted \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slots, grants, txn, phase>>

SlotFree(s) == \A g \in grants : g.slot # s

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ voted = Participants
    /\ txn.slot \in slots
    /\ SlotFree(txn.slot)
    /\ grants' = grants \cup {[slot |-> txn.slot, bag |-> txn.bag]}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ txn' = NoTxn
    /\ voted' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED slots

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ txn' = NoTxn
    /\ voted' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slots, grants>>

AddSlot(s) ==
    /\ slots' = slots \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, txn, voted, phase>>

RemoveSlot(s) ==
    /\ s \in slots
    /\ slots' = slots \ {s}
    /\ grants' = {g \in grants : g.slot # s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, voted, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Bags, s \in AllSlots : Begin(b, s)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Vote(p)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ \E s \in AllSlots : AddSlot(s)
    \/ \E s \in AllSlots : RemoveSlot(s)

NoDoubleAllocation ==
    \A g1, g2 \in grants : (g1.slot = g2.slot) => (g1.bag = g2.bag)

vars == <<slots, grants, txn, voted, phase>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
nl:
An airport baggage router assigns each incoming bag to a sortation chute slot using a two-phase commit across three participants: the scanner, the chute controller, and the belt controller. To route a bag the coordinator begins a transaction naming a bag and a target slot, then each participant casts a yes vote; the assignment is committed only once all three participants have voted and the target slot is still available and unoccupied. If the coordinator gives up, it aborts the transaction and nothing is assigned. The set of available slots changes at runtime: maintenance can bring a new slot online, increasing capacity, or take a slot offline, in which case any bag currently routed to that slot is pulled back. The core hazard is assigning the same slot to two different bags at once. The model tracks the available slots, the committed slot-to-bag grants, the in-flight transaction, the votes gathered, and the coordinator phase.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No sortation slot is ever committed to two different bags at the same time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m3p5t4 ----------------------------
(* Power-grid load shedder with leader-election failover. Tripping a feeder
   is irreversible; generation capacity varies at runtime. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Ctls    == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Feeders == {"f1", "f2", "f3"}
MaxCap  == 3
NoLeader == "none"

VARIABLES leader, alive, live, tripped, capacity

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Ctls \cup {NoLeader}
    /\ alive \subseteq Ctls
    /\ live \subseteq Feeders
    /\ tripped \subseteq Feeders
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ alive = Ctls
    /\ live = Feeders
    /\ tripped = {}
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

Elect(r) ==
    /\ (leader = NoLeader \/ leader \notin alive)
    /\ r \in alive
    /\ leader' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, live, tripped, capacity>>

CrashLeader ==
    /\ leader \in alive
    /\ alive' = alive \ {leader}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, live, tripped, capacity>>

Trip(f) ==
    /\ leader \in alive
    /\ f \in live
    /\ Cardinality(live) > capacity
    /\ live' = live \ {f}
    /\ tripped' = tripped \cup {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, capacity>>

Energize(f) ==
    /\ f \notin live
    /\ f \notin tripped
    /\ live' = live \cup {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, tripped, capacity>>

SetCapacity(c) ==
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, live, tripped>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Ctls : Elect(r)
    \/ CrashLeader
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Trip(f)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Energize(f)
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : SetCapacity(c)

TrippedStayShed == tripped \cap live = {}

vars == <<leader, alive, live, tripped, capacity>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TrippedStayShed
nl:
A power-grid load shedder is coordinated by an elected leader controller that decides when to shed feeders during an overload. When generation capacity cannot cover the currently energized feeders, the leader may trip a feeder to shed load. Tripping a feeder is irreversible: a tripped feeder is permanently disconnected for the rest of the event and can never be re-energized, though feeders that have never been tripped can be energized and de-energized freely as conditions allow. The available generation capacity changes at runtime as generators ramp up or down. The controllers run an election with failover: the leader can crash and drop out of the live controller set, after which the survivors elect a new leader so shedding decisions can continue. The model tracks the leader, the live controllers, the currently energized feeders, the permanently tripped feeders, and the available capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A feeder that has been tripped is never among the energized feeders again.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m5p3t5 ----------------------------
(* Wildfire drone swarm: quorum-voted sector assignment with a privileged
   admin override that bypasses the quorum. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Members == {"m1", "m2", "m3"}
Sectors == {"z1", "z2"}
Drones  == {"d1", "d2"}
Quorum  == 2
NoProp  == [sector |-> "-", drone |-> "-"]

VARIABLES grants, proposal, votes, phase

TypeOK ==
    /\ grants \subseteq [sector: Sectors, drone: Drones]
    /\ proposal \in ([sector: Sectors, drone: Drones] \cup {NoProp})
    /\ votes \subseteq Members
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}

Init ==
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ proposal = NoProp
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ phase = "idle"

SectorFree(s) == \A g \in grants : g.sector # s

Propose(s, d) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ SectorFree(s)
    /\ proposal' = [sector |-> s, drone |-> d]
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED grants

CastVote(v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ v \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, proposal, phase>>

CommitByQuorum ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ SectorFree(proposal.sector)
    /\ grants' = grants \cup {proposal}
    /\ proposal' = NoProp
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ phase' = "idle"

Reject ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ proposal' = NoProp
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED grants

AdminOverride(s, d) ==
    /\ SectorFree(s)
    /\ grants' = grants \cup {[sector |-> s, drone |-> d]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, votes, phase>>

Recall(s, d) ==
    /\ [sector |-> s, drone |-> d] \in grants
    /\ grants' = grants \ {[sector |-> s, drone |-> d]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, votes, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Sectors, d \in Drones : Propose(s, d)
    \/ \E v \in Members : CastVote(v)
    \/ CommitByQuorum
    \/ Reject
    \/ \E s \in Sectors, d \in Drones : AdminOverride(s, d)
    \/ \E s \in Sectors, d \in Drones : Recall(s, d)

NoDoubleCover ==
    \A g1, g2 \in grants : (g1.sector = g2.sector) => (g1.drone = g2.drone)

vars == <<grants, proposal, votes, phase>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleCover
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm assigns drones to observation sectors, and every assignment must be ratified by a quorum of swarm members before it takes effect. To assign a drone to a sector, a proposal naming the sector and drone is opened, swarm members cast votes, and the assignment commits only once a quorum has voted and the target sector is still unoccupied. A proposal that stalls can be rejected, discarding it. A privileged flight administrator holds an override that can assign a drone to a free sector directly, without gathering a quorum, for urgent repositioning. A drone can also be recalled from a sector, freeing it. The overriding safety concern is that a single sector must never be covered by two different drones at once. The model tracks the committed sector-to-drone grants, the open proposal, the votes gathered, and the voting phase.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No observation sector is ever assigned to two different drones at the same time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m1p2t1 ----------------------------
(* University course registration: a token ring grants exclusive access to a
   conserved seat pool; enrollment requests arrive reorderable. *)
EXTENDS Naturals

Nodes    == {"r1", "r2", "r3"}
Students == {"s1", "s2"}
Capacity == 3

VARIABLES tokenAt, pending, available, enrolled

TypeOK ==
    /\ tokenAt \in Nodes
    /\ pending \subseteq Students
    /\ available \in 0..Capacity
    /\ enrolled \in 0..Capacity

Init ==
    /\ tokenAt = "r1"
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ available = Capacity
    /\ enrolled = 0

PassToken(n) ==
    /\ tokenAt' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, available, enrolled>>

Request(st) ==
    /\ st \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {st}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, available, enrolled>>

Enroll(st) ==
    /\ st \in pending
    /\ available > 0
    /\ available' = available - 1
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled + 1
    /\ pending' = pending \ {st}
    /\ UNCHANGED tokenAt

Drop ==
    /\ enrolled > 0
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled - 1
    /\ available' = available + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : PassToken(n)
    \/ \E st \in Students : Request(st)
    \/ \E st \in Students : Enroll(st)
    \/ Drop

SeatConservation == available + enrolled = Capacity

vars == <<tokenAt, pending, available, enrolled>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SeatConservation
nl:
A university course-registration system coordinates several registrar nodes with a circulating token that grants exclusive access to a single course's seat pool. Only the node currently holding the token may change enrollments, and the token is passed around the ring from node to node. Students submit enrollment requests that collect in a pending pool; because these requests travel over an unreliable network they can be reordered, so the holding node may serve any pending request, not necessarily in submission order. The seat pool has a fixed capacity split between available seats and enrolled seats; enrolling a student moves one seat from available to enrolled, and a drop moves one seat back. No seats are ever created or destroyed. The model tracks which node holds the token, the pending enrollment requests, the available seats, and the enrolled seats.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The available seats plus the enrolled seats always equal the course's fixed capacity.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m7p5t0 ----------------------------
(* Power-grid load shedder electing a one-shot shed authority via a write-once
   compare-and-swap register; controllers may crash silently. *)
EXTENDS Naturals

Ctls  == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Unset == "0"
None  == "none"

VARIABLES reg, executedBy, alive, obs

TypeOK ==
    /\ reg \in {Unset} \cup Ctls
    /\ executedBy \in {None} \cup Ctls
    /\ alive \subseteq Ctls
    /\ obs \in [Ctls -> {Unset} \cup Ctls]

Init ==
    /\ reg = Unset
    /\ executedBy = None
    /\ alive = Ctls
    /\ obs = [c \in Ctls |-> Unset]

Observe(c) ==
    /\ obs' = [obs EXCEPT ![c] = reg]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, executedBy, alive>>

TryCAS(c) ==
    /\ c \in alive
    /\ obs[c] = Unset
    /\ reg = Unset
    /\ reg' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<executedBy, alive, obs>>

Execute ==
    /\ reg # Unset
    /\ executedBy = None
    /\ executedBy' = reg
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, alive, obs>>

CrashSilent(c) ==
    /\ c \in alive
    /\ alive' = alive \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, executedBy, obs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Ctls : Observe(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctls : TryCAS(c)
    \/ Execute
    \/ \E c \in Ctls : CrashSilent(c)

ExecMatchesWinner ==
    (executedBy # None) => (executedBy = reg /\ reg # Unset)

vars == <<reg, executedBy, alive, obs>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ExecMatchesWinner
nl:
A power-grid load shedder uses a single compare-and-swap register to decide, across several controllers, who is authorized to issue the one irreversible emergency shed command for an event. Each controller first observes the register's current value, then attempts a compare-and-swap: if the register is still unclaimed the controller swaps in its own identity, becoming the winner; if another controller already claimed it, the swap fails. Once the register has a winner, the emergency shed can be executed exactly once, and it is attributed to whoever won the register. Any controller may crash silently and drop out without notice, but a crash does not undo a claim that was already made. The register is write-once: after a winner is recorded it never changes. The model tracks the register value, who executed the shed, the live controllers, and each controller's last observed register value.
SAFETY PROPERTY: If the emergency shed has been executed, it was executed by exactly the controller that won the compare-and-swap register.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m9p3t1 ----------------------------
(* Elevator bank dispatch with epoch-numbered reconfiguration and reorderable
   floor-call messages; a call is never double-dispatched. *)
EXTENDS Naturals

Floors   == {"fl1", "fl2"}
Cars     == {"e1", "e2"}
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES grants, epoch, requests, busy

TypeOK ==
    /\ grants \subseteq [floor: Floors, car: Cars]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ requests \subseteq Floors
    /\ busy \subseteq Cars

Init ==
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ requests = {}
    /\ busy = {}

FloorFree(f) == \A g \in grants : g.floor # f

Call(f) ==
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, epoch, busy>>

Assign(f, e) ==
    /\ f \in requests
    /\ FloorFree(f)
    /\ e \notin busy
    /\ grants' = grants \cup {[floor |-> f, car |-> e]}
    /\ busy' = busy \cup {e}
    /\ requests' = requests \ {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

Complete(f, e) ==
    /\ [floor |-> f, car |-> e] \in grants
    /\ grants' = grants \ {[floor |-> f, car |-> e]}
    /\ busy' = busy \ {e}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, requests>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ grants' = {}
    /\ busy' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED requests

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Floors : Call(f)
    \/ \E f \in Floors, e \in Cars : Assign(f, e)
    \/ \E f \in Floors, e \in Cars : Complete(f, e)
    \/ Reconfigure

NoDoubleDispatch ==
    \A g1, g2 \in grants : (g1.floor = g2.floor) => (g1.car = g2.car)

vars == <<grants, epoch, requests, busy>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleDispatch
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper dispatches cars to answer floor calls. Floor calls arrive as messages that collect in a pending set; because the calls travel over the building bus they can be reordered, so the dispatcher may answer any pending call, not necessarily in the order it was pressed. Assigning a call gives it to a currently idle car, and the car becomes busy until it completes the call and goes idle again. Assignments belong to a configuration epoch: periodically the controller performs an epoch-numbered reconfiguration that increments the epoch and clears every outstanding assignment and busy marker, for instance after a maintenance rebalance. The hazard being guarded against is that a single floor call is answered by two different cars at the same time. The model tracks the current assignments, the epoch number, the pending floor calls, and the set of busy cars.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No floor call is ever assigned to two different elevator cars at the same time.

    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![w] = NoTask]

    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![b] = a]

    /\ acked' = [acked EXCEPT ![w] = acked[w] \cup {it}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rv, capacity>>

    /\ rv[w] # version
    /\ rv' = [rv EXCEPT ![w] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, version, acked, capacity>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, version, rv, acked>>

MaxTerm == 2
NoLeader == "none"

Bump(t) == IF t < MaxTerm THEN t + 1 ELSE t

    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ finalized \subseteq Batches
    /\ permit \in [Batches -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ view \in [Coords -> 0..MaxTerm]

    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ term = 0
    /\ finalized = {}
    /\ permit = [b \in Batches |-> TRUE]
    /\ view = [c \in Coords |-> 0]

    /\ leader' = c
    /\ term' = Bump(term)
    /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![c] = Bump(term)]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<finalized, permit>>

    /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![c] = term]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, finalized, permit>>

    /\ leader = c
    /\ view[c] = term
    /\ permit[b] = TRUE
    /\ finalized' = finalized \cup {b}
    /\ permit' = [permit EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, view>>

    /\ leader # NoLeader
    /\ leader' = NoLeader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, finalized, permit, view>>

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m4p6t5 ----------------------------
(* Print shop spooler: bounded backpressured queue; a job may be started only
   by its owner, with a privileged admin override that can start or reset any
   job. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

Jobs  == {"j1", "j2"}
Users == {"u1", "u2"}
Admin == "admin"
MaxQ  == 2
None  == "none"

InQueue(j, q) == \E i \in DOMAIN q : q[i] = j
Remove(j, q)  == SelectSeq(q, LAMBDA x : x # j)

VARIABLES queue, owner, startedBy, printing

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Jobs)
    /\ Len(queue) <= MaxQ
    /\ owner \in [Jobs -> {None} \cup Users]
    /\ startedBy \in [Jobs -> {None} \cup Users \cup {Admin}]
    /\ printing \in {None} \cup Jobs

Init ==
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ owner = [j \in Jobs |-> None]
    /\ startedBy = [j \in Jobs |-> None]
    /\ printing = None

Enqueue(j, u) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < MaxQ
    /\ owner[j] = None
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![j] = u]
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, j)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<startedBy, printing>>

StartOwn(j, u) ==
    /\ InQueue(j, queue)
    /\ owner[j] = u
    /\ printing = None
    /\ printing' = j
    /\ startedBy' = [startedBy EXCEPT ![j] = u]
    /\ queue' = Remove(j, queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

StartAdmin(j) ==
    /\ InQueue(j, queue)
    /\ printing = None
    /\ printing' = j
    /\ startedBy' = [startedBy EXCEPT ![j] = Admin]
    /\ queue' = Remove(j, queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Finish ==
    /\ printing # None
    /\ printing' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, owner, startedBy>>

AdminReset(j) ==
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![j] = None]
    /\ startedBy' = [startedBy EXCEPT ![j] = None]
    /\ queue' = Remove(j, queue)
    /\ printing' = IF printing = j THEN None ELSE printing

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, u \in Users : Enqueue(j, u)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, u \in Users : StartOwn(j, u)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : StartAdmin(j)
    \/ Finish
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : AdminReset(j)

AuthorizedStart ==
    \A j \in Jobs :
        (startedBy[j] # None) => (startedBy[j] = owner[j] \/ startedBy[j] = Admin)

vars == <<queue, owner, startedBy, printing>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AuthorizedStart
nl:
A print shop job spooler holds submitted print jobs in a bounded queue with backpressure: a new job can be spooled only while the queue has room, and when it is full further submissions are blocked. Each job records the user who submitted it as its owner. A job can be started on the printer only by its owner, and only one job prints at a time; when printing finishes the printer frees up. A privileged shop administrator holds an override: the administrator may start any queued job on the printer regardless of owner, and may also reset any job entirely, clearing its owner and pulling it from the queue or the printer. The safety concern is that a job must only ever be started by an authorized party, meaning its own owner or the administrator, never by some other or stale user. The model tracks the print queue, each job's owner, who started each job, and the job currently printing.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every job that has been started on the printer was started by either its own owner or the administrator.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m6p2t5 ----------------------------
(* Smart-home lock network: lease-based network control with expiry and an
   admin override, over a conserved pool of digital keys. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Locks     == {"lk1", "lk2"}
Residents == {"us1", "us2"}
Total     == 2
MaxT      == 2
None      == "none"

VARIABLES vault, atLock, holder, deadline, clock

KeysAtLocks == Cardinality({l \in Locks : atLock[l]})

TypeOK ==
    /\ vault \in 0..Total
    /\ atLock \in [Locks -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ holder \in {None} \cup Residents
    /\ deadline \in 0..MaxT
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT

Init ==
    /\ vault = Total
    /\ atLock = [l \in Locks |-> FALSE]
    /\ holder = None
    /\ deadline = 0
    /\ clock = 0

AcquireLease(u, d) ==
    /\ holder = None
    /\ d > clock
    /\ holder' = u
    /\ deadline' = d
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, atLock, clock>>

AdminSetLease(u) ==
    /\ holder' = u
    /\ deadline' = MaxT
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, atLock, clock>>

ExpireLease ==
    /\ holder # None
    /\ clock >= deadline
    /\ holder' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, atLock, deadline, clock>>

Provision(l) ==
    /\ holder # None
    /\ vault > 0
    /\ ~atLock[l]
    /\ vault' = vault - 1
    /\ atLock' = [atLock EXCEPT ![l] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, deadline, clock>>

Reclaim(l) ==
    /\ holder # None
    /\ atLock[l]
    /\ vault' = vault + 1
    /\ atLock' = [atLock EXCEPT ![l] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, deadline, clock>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, atLock, holder, deadline>>

Next ==
    \/ \E u \in Residents, d \in 1..MaxT : AcquireLease(u, d)
    \/ \E u \in Residents : AdminSetLease(u)
    \/ ExpireLease
    \/ \E l \in Locks : Provision(l)
    \/ \E l \in Locks : Reclaim(l)
    \/ Tick

KeyConservation == vault + KeysAtLocks = Total

vars == <<vault, atLock, holder, deadline, clock>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT KeyConservation
nl:
A smart-home door lock network manages a fixed set of digital keys that live either in the central vault or provisioned into the individual door locks; keys are never minted or destroyed, only moved between the vault and the locks. Control of the network is governed by a lease with an expiry: a resident acquires the control lease with a deadline, and once the household clock passes that deadline the lease expires and control is released. While holding a valid lease a resident may provision a key from the vault into a free lock, or reclaim a key from a lock back into the vault. A privileged home administrator holds an override that can install the control lease for any resident at any time, bypassing the normal acquisition. The model tracks the vault key count, which locks currently hold a key, the current lease holder, the lease deadline, and the household clock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The keys in the vault plus the keys provisioned into locks always equal the fixed total number of digital keys.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m6p1t4 ----------------------------
(* Air-traffic runway allocator: a lease with expiry gates writes to a shared
   assignment table; acknowledged clearances are never lost; runway capacity
   varies at runtime. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Runways     == {"rw1", "rw2"}
Flights     == {"f1", "f2"}
Controllers == {"c1", "c2"}
MaxT        == 2
MaxCap      == 2
None        == "none"

VARIABLES record, acked, holder, deadline, clock, capacity

Assigned == {rw \in Runways : record[rw] # None}

TypeOK ==
    /\ record \in [Runways -> {None} \cup Flights]
    /\ acked \subseteq [runway: Runways, flight: Flights]
    /\ holder \in {None} \cup Controllers
    /\ deadline \in 0..MaxT
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ record = [rw \in Runways |-> None]
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ holder = None
    /\ deadline = 0
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

AcquireLease(c, d) ==
    /\ holder = None
    /\ d > clock
    /\ holder' = c
    /\ deadline' = d
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, clock, capacity>>

ExpireLease ==
    /\ holder # None
    /\ clock >= deadline
    /\ holder' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, deadline, clock, capacity>>

Commit(c, rw, fl) ==
    /\ holder = c
    /\ record[rw] = None
    /\ Cardinality(Assigned) < capacity
    /\ record' = [record EXCEPT ![rw] = fl]
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {[runway |-> rw, flight |-> fl]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, deadline, clock, capacity>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, holder, deadline, capacity>>

SetCap(k) ==
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, holder, deadline, clock>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, d \in 1..MaxT : AcquireLease(c, d)
    \/ ExpireLease
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, rw \in Runways, fl \in Flights : Commit(c, rw, fl)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCap : SetCap(k)

NoLostClearance == \A p \in acked : record[p.runway] = p.flight

vars == <<record, acked, holder, deadline, clock, capacity>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostClearance
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator maintains a shared assignment table mapping each runway to the flight cleared to use it. Write access to the table is governed by a lease with an expiry: a controller acquires the write lease with a deadline, and once the clock passes that deadline the lease expires and write access is released. Only the controller currently holding a valid lease may commit an assignment, and only for a runway that is currently free, at which point the assignment is recorded and the controller is acknowledged that its clearance landed. The number of runways available for assignment changes at runtime as runways open and close, and a new assignment is permitted only while the number of assigned runways is below the current capacity. The essential guarantee is that any acknowledged clearance still stands in the shared table exactly as issued. The model tracks the assignment table, the acknowledged clearances, the lease holder, the lease deadline, the clock, and the current capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every acknowledged clearance, the shared table still maps that runway to exactly the acknowledged flight.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m5p0t2 ----------------------------
(* Airport baggage router: two instances share one critical resource; entry to
   the critical section is decided by quorum voting; mutual exclusion holds. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Requesters == {"a1", "a2", "b1", "b2"}
Quorum     == 2
None       == "none"

VARIABLES pc, bid, votes, phase

SomeoneCritical == \E r \in Requesters : pc[r] = "critical"

TypeOK ==
    /\ pc \in [Requesters -> {"idle", "waiting", "critical"}]
    /\ bid \in {None} \cup Requesters
    /\ votes \subseteq Requesters
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}

Init ==
    /\ pc = [r \in Requesters |-> "idle"]
    /\ bid = None
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ phase = "idle"

RaiseRequest(r) ==
    /\ pc[r] = "idle"
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![r] = "waiting"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bid, votes, phase>>

OpenBid(r) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ pc[r] = "waiting"
    /\ ~SomeoneCritical
    /\ bid' = r
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED pc

CastVote(v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ v \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pc, bid, phase>>

Grant ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ ~SomeoneCritical
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![bid] = "critical"]
    /\ bid' = None
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ phase' = "idle"

CloseBid ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ bid' = None
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED pc

Exit(r) ==
    /\ pc[r] = "critical"
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![r] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bid, votes, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Requesters : RaiseRequest(r)
    \/ \E r \in Requesters : OpenBid(r)
    \/ \E v \in Requesters : CastVote(v)
    \/ Grant
    \/ CloseBid
    \/ \E r \in Requesters : Exit(r)

MutualExclusion ==
    \A a, b \in Requesters :
        (pc[a] = "critical" /\ pc[b] = "critical") => (a = b)

vars == <<pc, bid, votes, phase>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
An airport baggage router has two independent router instances whose requesters contend for a single shared critical sortation resource drawn from one common pool. Each requester moves through control states: it starts idle, may raise a request and become waiting, and can enter the critical section only after being granted. Entry is decided by quorum voting: while no requester holds the critical resource, a waiting requester's bid is opened, the requesters cast votes, and the bid is granted once a quorum has voted and the critical resource is still free. On being granted, the requester enters the critical section, and it later exits back to idle, freeing the resource. Because both instances draw from the same pool, the router must guarantee that the shared critical resource is never held by two requesters at once. The model tracks each requester's control state, the open bid, the votes gathered, and the voting phase.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one requester is ever in the critical section at the same time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m7p0t0 ----------------------------
(* Air-traffic runway allocator: mutual exclusion over one runway via a
   compare-and-swap lock register; controllers may crash silently. *)
EXTENDS Naturals

Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Free        == "free"

VARIABLES lock, pc, obs, alive

TypeOK ==
    /\ lock \in {Free} \cup Controllers
    /\ pc \in [Controllers -> {"idle", "trying", "critical"}]
    /\ obs \in [Controllers -> {Free} \cup Controllers]
    /\ alive \subseteq Controllers

Init ==
    /\ lock = Free
    /\ pc = [c \in Controllers |-> "idle"]
    /\ obs = [c \in Controllers |-> Free]
    /\ alive = Controllers

Signal(c) ==
    /\ pc[c] = "idle"
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![c] = "trying"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, obs, alive>>

Observe(c) ==
    /\ obs' = [obs EXCEPT ![c] = lock]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, pc, alive>>

TryAcquire(c) ==
    /\ c \in alive
    /\ pc[c] = "trying"
    /\ obs[c] = Free
    /\ lock = Free
    /\ lock' = c
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![c] = "critical"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<obs, alive>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ pc[c] = "critical"
    /\ lock = c
    /\ lock' = Free
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<obs, alive>>

CrashSilent(c) ==
    /\ c \in alive
    /\ alive' = alive \ {c}
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, obs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Signal(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Observe(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : TryAcquire(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Release(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : CrashSilent(c)

CriticalHoldsLock ==
    \A c \in Controllers : (pc[c] = "critical") => (lock = c)

vars == <<lock, pc, obs, alive>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CriticalHoldsLock
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator lets several controllers contend for exclusive use of a single runway through a compare-and-swap lock register. The register is either free or holds the identity of the controller currently granted the runway. A controller that wants the runway first signals intent, then observes the register and attempts a compare-and-swap: if the register still reads free it swaps in its own identity and enters the critical section holding the runway. The holder later releases the runway by setting the register back to free. Any controller may crash silently and drop out of the live set; a controller that crashes leaves the critical section, though if it crashed while holding the register the runway stays marked until manually cleared. The overriding requirement is that only the controller recorded in the lock register is ever using the runway, which keeps the runway mutually exclusive. The model tracks the lock register, each controller's control state, each controller's last observed register value, and the live controllers.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any controller in the critical section is exactly the controller currently recorded as the holder of the lock register.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m8p6t2 ----------------------------
(* Interbank settlement: two instances share one account pool; account writes
   require hierarchical (coarse-then-fine) locks, so no unauthorized or stale
   instance can have a write in progress. *)
EXTENDS Naturals

Instances == {"I1", "I2"}
Accounts  == {"ac1", "ac2"}
None      == "none"

VARIABLES coarse, fine, writer, log

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in {None} \cup Instances
    /\ fine \in [Accounts -> {None} \cup Instances]
    /\ writer \in [Accounts -> {None} \cup Instances]
    /\ log \subseteq [acct: Accounts, by: Instances]

Init ==
    /\ coarse = None
    /\ fine = [a \in Accounts |-> None]
    /\ writer = [a \in Accounts |-> None]
    /\ log = {}

AcquireCoarse(i) ==
    /\ coarse = None
    /\ coarse' = i
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, writer, log>>

AcquireFine(i, a) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ fine[a] = None
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![a] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, writer, log>>

BeginWrite(i, a) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ fine[a] = i
    /\ writer[a] = None
    /\ writer' = [writer EXCEPT ![a] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, log>>

Commit(i, a) ==
    /\ writer[a] = i
    /\ log' = log \cup {[acct |-> a, by |-> i]}
    /\ writer' = [writer EXCEPT ![a] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

ReleaseAll(i) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ coarse' = None
    /\ fine' = [a \in Accounts |-> IF fine[a] = i THEN None ELSE fine[a]]
    /\ writer' = [a \in Accounts |-> IF writer[a] = i THEN None ELSE writer[a]]
    /\ UNCHANGED log

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : AcquireCoarse(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, a \in Accounts : AcquireFine(i, a)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, a \in Accounts : BeginWrite(i, a)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, a \in Accounts : Commit(i, a)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : ReleaseAll(i)

AuthorizedWrite ==
    \A a \in Accounts :
        (writer[a] # None) => (coarse = writer[a] /\ fine[a] = writer[a])

vars == <<coarse, fine, writer, log>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AuthorizedWrite
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch runs two independent settlement instances that share one common pool of accounts. Writes to accounts are protected by a hierarchical locking discipline: an instance must first acquire the coarse batch lock, and only while holding it may it acquire the fine per-account locks. An instance may begin a write on an account only while it holds both the coarse lock and that account's fine lock, marking the account as having a write in progress by that instance; it later commits the write into the settlement log and clears the in-progress marker. When an instance releases, it drops the coarse lock and all fine locks and abandons any of its still-in-progress writes. Because two instances share the pool, the danger is a write in progress by an instance that does not actually hold the required locks, that is, an unauthorized or stale writer. The model tracks the coarse lock holder, the per-account fine lock holders, each account's in-progress writer, and the committed settlement log.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any account with a write in progress is held under both the coarse lock and that account's fine lock by exactly the instance doing the write.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m1p5t3 ----------------------------
(* Power-grid load shedder: a token ring grants exclusive shedding authority
   with slow (but never lost) token delivery; shedding a zone is irreversible. *)
EXTENDS Naturals

Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Zones       == {"z1", "z2"}
Transit     == "transit"
None        == "none"

VARIABLES tokenAt, inTransit, shed, live

TypeOK ==
    /\ tokenAt \in Controllers \cup {Transit}
    /\ inTransit \in Controllers \cup {None}
    /\ shed \subseteq Zones
    /\ live \subseteq Zones

Init ==
    /\ tokenAt = "c1"
    /\ inTransit = None
    /\ shed = {}
    /\ live = Zones

PassToken(c) ==
    /\ tokenAt \in Controllers
    /\ tokenAt' = Transit
    /\ inTransit' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shed, live>>

DeliverToken ==
    /\ tokenAt = Transit
    /\ tokenAt' = inTransit
    /\ inTransit' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shed, live>>

Shed(z) ==
    /\ tokenAt \in Controllers
    /\ z \in live
    /\ live' = live \ {z}
    /\ shed' = shed \cup {z}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, inTransit>>

Energize(z) ==
    /\ z \notin live
    /\ z \notin shed
    /\ live' = live \cup {z}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, inTransit, shed>>

Deenergize(z) ==
    /\ z \in live
    /\ z \notin shed
    /\ live' = live \ {z}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, inTransit, shed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : PassToken(c)
    \/ DeliverToken
    \/ \E z \in Zones : Shed(z)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : Energize(z)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : Deenergize(z)

ShedStaysDark == shed \cap live = {}

vars == <<tokenAt, inTransit, shed, live>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ShedStaysDark
nl:
A power-grid load shedder coordinates several controllers with a circulating token that grants exclusive shedding authority. Only the controller currently holding the token may shed a zone. The token is passed around the ring, but the network is slow: a passed token spends time in transit before it is delivered to the next controller, and although delivery can be arbitrarily delayed the token is never lost, since participants are slow but never fail. Shedding a zone is irreversible: once a zone is shed it is permanently de-energized for the rest of the event and can never be re-energized, whereas a zone that has never been shed may be energized and de-energized freely. The safety concern is that a zone that has been shed must never appear among the energized zones again. The model tracks which controller holds the token, the token in transit, the permanently shed zones, and the currently energized zones.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No zone that has been shed is ever among the energized zones.
